meta.note: Engine rules and value judgements that do not come from the person's data. Growth of prices, wages and rents is in macro.json; the sensitivity copies its base and range so the engine and the analysis agree.

sensitivity.source: No data on job-search time. The events start the new job right when the studies end (startOffsetMonths 24); 0-6 extra months is our range to test how much a slower start would change the decision
tools/out/macro.json trends.priceInflationAnnual: mean Swiss CPI inflation 2000-2025; low/high = p10/p90 of the yearly values
tools/out/macro.json trends.wageGrowthAnnual: mean nominal growth of the BFS Swiss wage index 2000-2025; low/high = p10/p90

label.EN: Rent growth if you do not move (per year)
label.ES: Subida del alquiler si no te mudas (anual)

sensitivity.source: tools/out/macro.json trends.rentGrowthSittingTenantAnnual: mean yearly change of the BFS rent price index 2000-2025 (all rented dwellings: mostly sitting tenants, whose rents follow the reference mortgage rate and CPI by law); low/high = p10/p90
synthetic-liabilities.csv annual_interest_rate (n=283): base = max (the engine's default), low = min
No return data in the dataset: base 0 (the engine's default). High = mean 10-year Confederation bond yield 2000-2025 (1.351 %, SNB via macro.json); the last 10 years averaged 0.124 %

sourceNotes: financingRateAnnual 0.085: interest on negative cash = the highest loan rate in synthetic-liabilities.csv (0.0848), so going negative is never cheaper than a loan.

investmentReturnAnnual 0: the dataset has portfolio values but no returns; equity returns were not downloaded (FRED failed). Conservative reference: 10-year Confederation bonds averaged 0.124 % over the last 10 years.
defaultCaseProbs 0.2 / 0.6 / 0.2: our convention for events whose cases have no data (content/README.md rule 4).
objectivePenalties CHF 0 / 500 / 3000 per month below the minimum cushion for GROWTH / BALANCED / SAFE: value judgements, shown to the user (docs/README.md section 9).
sensitivity: low/high are the data spread when there is data (see each parameter's source); ASSUMED otherwise.
